note: Bifid epiglottis and anorectal malformations are hallmark features of Pallister-Hall syndrome (GLI3-PHS) and are recognized discriminators rare in other ciliopathy syndromes.

evidence.text: Bifid epiglottis is highlighted as a key clinical diagnostic indicator that is exceptionally rare outside of GLI3-related Pallister-Hall syndrome, which also features anal atresia or stenosis.
